title: Nike Summer Brand campaign underpacing — projected to miss delivery
body: Nike Summer Brand campaign (LI-5502, guaranteed 2,000,000 impressions over 10 days) is pacing at a projected 72% delivery with 4 days remaining. At the current rate it will under-deliver by roughly 560,000 impressions, which would breach the delivery guarantee and trigger make-good obligations. The line item shares the ife-premium-video ad unit with other campaigns.
